# Spread of print

> [!summary]
> Print spread along trade routes: from Mainz to Venice, Basel and Lyon within one generation.

*Part of [[Printing press]], section 1.*

## Trade routes, not borders
Printers went where paper, money and readers were: the trading cities (Handelsstädte) of the Rhine and northern Italy.

> [!shaky]
> The figure of 20 million books by 1500 is an estimate; ranges in the literature go from 8 to 20 million.

| City | First press |
|---|---|
| Mainz | 1450 |
| Venice | 1469 |
| Lyon | 1473 |
